# eservices.housingauthority.gov.hk

> Hong Kong Housing Authority's e-Services platform for contractor registration, public housing records management, and property services administration.

This site provides digital services for the Housing Authority's operations in Hong Kong, including contractor management systems (COMIS) and electronic building records (e-BROS). It serves as a central hub for contractor registration, compliance, and public housing information systems.

## Key Topics

- Housing Authority
- Public Housing Electronic Building Records Online System (e-BROS)
- COMIS - COunterparty Management Information System
- Contractor Registration
- Building Contractors
- Demolition Contractors
- Works Contractors
- Piling Contractors
- Lift and Escalator Contractors
- Property Services Agents
- Property Management
- Application Process
- System Maintenance
- Customer Support
- Hong Kong Public Housing

## Contractor Registration & Management

- [COMIS - Guide to Contractor Registration](https://eservices.housingauthority.gov.hk/ncomis-pub/guidelines/guide-to-reg): Guide to contractor registration in COMIS for building and demolition contractors

## Support & System Information

- [Contact Us - e-BROS Support](https://eservices.housingauthority.gov.hk/hebros/home/contactUs?locale=en): Contact information and support details for e-BROS public housing system
- [System Maintenance Schedule - e-BROS](https://eservices.housingauthority.gov.hk/hebros/home/maintenance?locale=en): System maintenance schedule and status for e-BROS online platform
